verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a real-time communications platform with a console, REST APIs, a CLI and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once: the REST API mention covers single actions like creating a project and fetching usage, and the CLI/MCP references describe agent connectivity, not batch operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
